essentialIdeas: Prewar European alliances and tensions made a wider war more likely before 1914.
The Sarajevo assassination set off the July Crisis, which moved through ultimatums, mobilization, and declarations of war.
From 1914 to 1918, the war began in Europe, expanded through new entries, and ended with the armistice in 1918.

methodBriefing.name: Feynman Technique
methodBriefing.what: Explain an idea in plain language, compare it with an accurate source, repair the gaps, and explain it again.
methodBriefing.why: Connecting steps, causes, and prior knowledge can expose shallow understanding and build a more useful mental model.
how: Study one concise explanation or example.
Close it and explain the idea in your own words.
Name the cause, relationship, or reason behind each important step.
Compare with the source, repair the explanation, then teach it back again without copying.
methodBriefing.completion: The explanation accurately includes the central relationship and at least one supporting reason or example.

activities.label: Learn
activities.title: Rival blocs in Europe
activities.body: Read the explanation, then answer the next question from memory.

essentialIdeas: Prewar European alliances and tensions split major powers into rival blocs before 1914.

activities.label: Explain
activities.title: Rival blocs in Europe
activities.body: How did prewar European alliances shape tensions among the major powers before 1914?
activities.concept: Prewar European alliances and tensions split major powers into rival blocs before 1914.
activities.correctAnswer: They divided the major powers into rival blocs, increasing suspicion and making a local crisis more likely to spread.
activities.feedback: The key relationship is bloc division leading to greater tension, not a specific battle or treaty detail.

activities.label: Learn
activities.title: From assassination to war
activities.body: Read the explanation, then answer the next question from memory.

essentialIdeas: The Sarajevo assassination triggered Austria-Hungary's ultimatum, then a widening chain of war declarations.
Basic chronology from 1914 to 1918 places the First World War between those years.

activities.label: Explain
activities.title: From assassination to war
activities.body: What sequence linked the Sarajevo assassination to the first declarations of war?
activities.concept: The Sarajevo assassination triggered Austria-Hungary's ultimatum, then a widening chain of war
activities.correctAnswer: The assassination led Austria-Hungary to issue an ultimatum, which escalated into declarations of war and wider mobilization.
activities.feedback: Focus on the escalation chain from assassination to ultimatum to war declarations.

activities.label: Explain
activities.title: War years
activities.body: What is the basic chronology of the First World War?
activities.concept: Basic chronology from 1914 to 1918 places the First World War between those years.
activities.feedback: The correct chronology is the war's start and end years, not later peace terms.

activities.label: Repair
activities.title: Repair the first explanation
activities.body: Compare the first explanation with this verified reference: They divided the major powers into rival blocs, increasing suspicion and making a local crisis more likely to spread. Correct the exposed relationship in your own words without copying the reference.
activities.concept: Prewar European alliances and tensions split major powers into rival blocs before 1914.
activities.correctAnswer: They divided the major powers into rival blocs, increasing suspicion and making a local crisis more likely to spread.
activities.feedback: The key relationship is bloc division leading to greater tension, not a specific battle or treaty detail.

activities.label: Explain again
activities.title: Explain the corrected relationship again
activities.body: How did prewar European alliances shape tensions among the major powers before 1914? Explain it again after the repair without copying the model or reference answer.
activities.concept: Prewar European alliances and tensions split major powers into rival blocs before 1914.
activities.correctAnswer: They divided the major powers into rival blocs, increasing suspicion and making a local crisis more likely to spread.
activities.feedback: The key relationship is bloc division leading to greater tension, not a specific battle or treaty detail.

activities.label: Recall check
activities.title: First World War dates
activities.body: Which years mark the basic chronology of the First World War?
activities.concept: Recognition transfer: Basic chronology from 1914 to 1918 places the First World War between those years.
activities.feedback: That range is the correct start and end chronology.
